name: domain-expert-core
description: Cross-domain task agents for architecture, troubleshooting, migrations, IaC, data governance, and security hardening. Includes ultimate-tech-stack: security-gated, open-source-preferred greenfield defaults with explicit exceptions when open source cannot safely meet the threat model. Also includes skill-builder: a multi-agent pipeline where parallel Sonnet researchers build a source-cited corpus and an Opus curator distills it into new marketplace skills.
